run.suite: full - confirmation run against the fixed build

fixes: #9 the toggle label is picked on task.isCompleted

device_setup: adb shell settings put global window_animation_scale 0
adb shell settings put global transition_animation_scale 0
adb shell settings put global animator_duration_scale 0
adb shell settings put system accelerometer_rotation 0
run.method: Each journey was reset with `am force-stop` and relaunched per its own preconditions. The screen was read with `adb exec-out uiautomator dump /dev/tty`; taps were resolved from the dump at run time. Colour assertions were checked against screenshots by eye.
run.compared_to: 2026-09-08-full-run.json, where TL-08, LC-03 and AX-02 failed. All three pass here. Two journeys, TL-01 and TL-04, were updated alongside the fix for #9: they named the checkbox label, which now follows the row's state.
